prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, mid 30s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob lavender hair — her body is covered in 4 different shiny materials at once, each material claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located at the middle of her bust, about 27% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 14%, 40% and 70% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries mirror chrome paint, a seamless liquid-mirror coat reflecting the light in sharp bright highlights. Her bust carries a large rose window of stained glass on each breast, radial petals of jewel-toned glass in deep blue, ruby red and gold held by thick black leading, a solid gold boss at the centre fully and opaquely covering her nipple and areola, the window spreading outward over the curve of her bust. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries cobalt-blue high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries applied copper leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright warm copper sheen. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries anodised titanium in iridescent blue, violet and gold bands, a metallic oxide shimmer. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring materials blend along the edge: the edge of one reaches into the other and the two simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, every material laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, her legs fully in view — most extreme siren bust hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy deep violet leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in deep violet lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: the ancient Parthenon terrace on the Acropolis in Athens, pale weathered marble paving, fluted columns and standard-height stone steps, empty of tourists, in clear sunny daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
